CommunityApplications.Profile:
Docker Safeguard is a self-hosted backup/restore tool for Docker apps on Unraid. It backs up a container's appdata and its full configuration (image, ports, env vars, mounts, network settings, and Unraid's own template) into one archive, then restores it so the app comes back up instantly runnable with the same data and options - not just files dumped into a folder. Save backups to any Unraid share or an external USB/NVMe/HDD. This repository contains the single Docker Safeguard application.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/docker-safeguard/issues
